# Structured decisions by institution, company, or university

[简体中文](../../../system-one/catalog/by-organization.md) · English

Papers are grouped by the first author's institution. Products and community projects are labeled separately so open-source authorship is not mistaken for paper affiliation.

## Independent Researcher

- [When Multiple Choices Are Correct](../../../system-one/2610.29217-jev-multicorrect/README-en.md) (2026-10-21, first author Rushab Munot): Distinguish normalized categorical shares from independently queried binary correctness probabilities; the former are not calibrated binary confidence. The paper studies Jev, Luna and Gemini. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Aalto University

- [Multimodal Reranking Is a System One Decision](../../../multimodal-models/2610.28435-system-one-rerank/README-en.md) (2026-10-20): Instead of generating a ranked list or training a separate pointwise reranker, the model scores each candidate by reading the probability of its letter label at the first answer position. The readout follows setwise and FIRST-style methods; the paper tests how this approach works zero-shot on images and visual documents, and whether text-only decision tuning transfers to visual reranking. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Câmara dos Deputados

- [Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking](../../../foundation-models/2610.23346-jev-portuguese-ir/README-en.md) (2026-10-16): On Quati it separately uses an independent Noul probability that each document directly answers the query, gathers every batch, and sorts the results. Candidates do not compete in a single Choice, probabilities are not mixed with BM25 scores, and there is no trained calibrator. **Evaluation protocol interface; not a model capability result.**

## TypeSafe AI

- [Jev](../implementations.md#official-jev): Official hosted System One model with a public typed Choice, Score and Noul decision protocol. Internal architecture, training data and weights are not released.

## Knowledgator

- [GLiClass](../../../foundation-models/2508.07662-gliclass/README-en.md) (2025-08-11): This avoids unstable parsing of generative LLM outputs and separate cross-encoder inference on each text–label pair. The repository retains the defining mechanisms: candidate content affects scores, and one normalization produces a distribution over all candidates.

## Nanyang Technological University

- [Prism-1](../../../foundation-models/2610.22066-prism-1/README-en.md) (2026-10-15): A softmax combines independent scores. Softmax alone cannot guarantee this without attention isolation and position reset. **Bounded component only; full experiments are not reproduced.**

## Massachusetts Institute of Technology

- [RLCR](../../../post-training/2507.16806-rlcr/README-en.md) (2025-07-22): RLCR predicts both an answer and its confidence and adds a bounded proper scoring rule so honest probabilities maximize expected reward. The local baseline minimizes multiclass Brier over the full candidate distribution.

## University of Southern California / AWS AI Labs

- [Calibration-Aware RL](../../../post-training/2601.13284-calibration-aware-rl/README-en.md) (2026-01-19): The paper adjusts decision-token probabilities directly to reduce ECE without sacrificing accuracy. The repository reports accuracy alongside Brier score and ECE, fits temperature only on validation, and forbids test-set tuning.

## Independent community implementations

- [Bespoke Labs — Nimble](https://github.com/bespokelabsai/nimble): Typed-schema logits model with public Qwen3.5-9B LoRA, data and recipe.
- [TianyuCodings — NanoJev](https://github.com/TianyuCodings/NanoJev): Qwen3-0.6B with Choice, Boolean and Score decision heads.
- [ConvAI Innovations — Laya](https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya): Public checkpoint, demo, fine-tuning and temperature-calibration path.
- [TheoLeeCJ — SemIf](https://github.com/TheoLeeCJ/SemIf): Engineering baseline with shared-state prefill and direct option logits.

This list covers priority integrations. See the [full 48-entry snapshot](../implementation-tracker.md) for other community authors and projects. Community attribution comes from public repositories and is not paper affiliation.
